text:
ryan: Morning all — async standup for the MacroHealth pipeline.
ryan: What I did: ran a demo yesterday (fed their data sample), uploaded updated KMS/HSM diagram to the shared folder, and emailed legal the high-level attestation request.
ryan: Blockers: customer insists on BYOK with on‑prem HSM attestation (FIPS/SOC requirements unclear). They also want deterministic latency SLO for dedicated nodes before signing.
ryan: Today: follow up with SE for on‑prem pricing outline, ask infra for a rotation + keywrap confirmation, and prep short FAQ for the customer.
anya: Saw the diagram — quick heads up: our Private deployment supports keywrap with KMIP-based HSMs, but we need customer HSM model + required FIPS level to confirm compatibility.
anya: I can join a deep‑dive if we get the model details. Also can draft the architecture slide showing network flow + termination points.
ryan: @anya — can you also include a note about network egress and whether they need a dedicated VPC peering? They asked about traffic path.
maria: From security: we need the customer's attestation template filled out before we can provide any vendor cert copies. Also confirm whether they require HSM-backed KMS or just encrypted disks with key control.
ryan: They explicitly asked for HSM-backed KMS and key rotation every 30 days.
maria: Ok — that pushes this to enterprise onboarding. I'll loop in legal for the attestation and DPPA language.
dinesh: Rotation: our KMS integration supports scheduled rotation for cloud KMS. For on‑prem HSM we'll need to run a small agent that calls the HSM vendor API. I can share the agent install steps and a sample config.
dinesh: Sample config snippet:
```
# /etc/redwood/kms-agent.conf
hsm_vendor = "thales"
hsm_endpoint = "10.0.0.5:2260"
key_wrap = true
rotation_cron = "0 0 */30 * *"
```
dinesh: Note: for some vendors we need a vendor SDK; we'll include that in the runbook.
anya: Actionable next steps I propose:
  1) Ryan: ask customer to confirm HSM vendor + model and their FIPS requirement (today)
  2) Dinesh: post agent install and rotation doc (ETA end of day)
  3) Maria: start attestation ticket with legal and attach our minimal disclosure (ETA EOD)
  4) Me: schedule architecture deep‑dive (Tue 10am PT) — will send calendar invite if that works.
kevin: FYI — customer also asked for a pricing estimate for a 3 node dedicated pool (SLA + burst). If we can't give SLO numbers this week it may delay their commit.
ryan: @kevin noted. I'll try to get a conservative SLO and a staging perf run for latency numbers.
maria: Legal note — if customer requires HSM vendor audit reports, we can provide redacted certs but need legal signoff. I'll ping legal now.
secops-bot: Reminder: new customer onboarding checklist created — /onboard 453. Please attach attestation forms and vendor model to ticket.
ryan: Thanks all. Quick ask: who can review the short FAQ I'll send to customer (2–3 bullets on BYOK+latency)?
anya: I can review after you drop it in the doc. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll check pricing language once you have the first draft.
maria: I'll add a security blurb to the FAQ.
ryan: Great — I'll circulate in ~30m and update this thread with any replies from the customer.
ryan: End of async update.
